_about: Settings for tools/build_meshes.py. Structures are PDB ids (fetched from RCSB into tools/cache) or paths to local .pdb files. Part names (brd4, vhl, elob, eloc, ub, warhead, e3lig) are what the story script looks for: keep them, and change what they are built from.

complex._structure: BRD4 bromodomain 2 + MZ1 + VHL/Elongin B/Elongin C. The file holds two copies of the complex; chains A-D are the first.

surface._about: Protein surfaces: a Gaussian blob per atom (sigma, A), cut at 'level', on a grid of 'grid' A, then smoothed. Lower level or larger sigma = puffier and smoother; smaller grid = more vertices.

degrader._residue: MZ1, bound in chain D's copy of the complex.
degrader._linker_atoms: The PEG linker, in order from the warhead side. Cutting these out leaves the two halves.

warhead._: JQ1, the half that holds the target (BRD4)

e3lig._: the VHL ligand, the half that holds the E3 ligase

degrader._layout: 'drawn': a flat textbook drawing of each half laid into its crystal pose (the website's look). 'crystal': the real 3D bond geometry.

outline._about: Each half is a tube along every bond, joined smoothly. scale shrinks or grows the drawing (1 = 1.5 A bonds); tube_radius and blend in A.
outline._facing: Which way each drawing faces, in the story's frame (x right, y up, z toward the viewer at the start). null fits the drawing to the crystal in 3D instead.
outline._trim_ends: Leave out end atoms (methyls, Cl, =O, -OH) so the outline shows the rings and chains.

ub._: ubiquitin; also used, squashed, as the stand-in E2
